   - Craft 1 Cyan Bed using 1 White Bed and 1 Cyan Dye.

2. Gather 4 String to craft 1 White Wool.
3. Use 3 White Wool and 4 Jungle Planks to craft 1 White Bed.
4. Gather 1 Lapis Lazuli to craft 1 Blue Dye.
5. Gather 1 White Dye (from White Wool) and 1 Blue Dye (from Lapis Lazuli) to craft 1 Cyan Dye.
6. Use 1 White Bed and 1 Cyan Dye to craft 1 Cyan Bed.

This sequence ensures we meet all requirements to produce the cyan bed.
